title: Red-Team Findings
description: Output of phases 1-2 of the standing red-team audit (agentteams --redteam): what was attacked, what held, and over which populations. Written to <report-dir>/findings.json. Machine-readable counterpart to discoveries.md.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp supplied by the caller, not read from the clock inside the engine, so a run is reproducible.

probe_module.description: Dotted import path of the probe module. Null when none was registered, in which case the attack phase did not run and the probe counts carry a denominator of zero — an unmeasured population, not a clean result.

probes.description: One entry per probe that recorded a result.

pid.description: Stable probe id; the key every ledger joins on.

name.description: Prefixed 'CONTROL:' when the probe establishes that the mechanism is engaged.

tier.description: T0 read content only, T1 in-repo agent with write+execute, T2 operator shell/env.

control.description: Paired control probe's pid. Null for a control probe, or for an attack probe exempted on the record in references/redteam-uncontrolled-probes.csv.

evidence_digest.description: SHA-256 prefix over the NORMALISED evidence — temp paths, timestamps, dates, hex digests and set-iteration order removed. Compared against references/redteam-probe-baseline.json by the F-5 intent check. Digesting raw evidence would flag every probe on every run.

counts.description: Every quantitative claim, each with the population it was computed over. A count cannot be constructed without a canonical population source: a numerator without its denominator is the failure that hid 719 exposed agents behind '0 agents on the ignored key across the fleet'.

note.description: Why a numerator is zero, or what a population excludes.

registration_problems.description: Attack probes with no declared control and no recorded exemption, controls naming controls, unresolvable control references, stale exemptions. Any entry means the HARNESS is broken.

control_failures.description: Pids of control probes that did not DEFEND. A battery whose controls fail measures a broken instrument and would report all-clear either way, so any entry maps to exit code 2, never 1.

corpus_mismatches.description: Judgment-layer payloads whose scanner_matches claim no longer agrees with agentteams.scan. The corpus describes a scanner that no longer exists.

exploited.description: Pids of ATTACK probes returning EXPLOITED — a measured attack is live. Controls are excluded here and reported through control_failures instead.
